case_title.quote: PURAN CHAND v. STATE OF H.P.
case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment caption.

number_of_accused.quote: The appellant was prosecuted for committing an offence punishable uls 376 IPC.
number_of_accused.reason: Single accused-appellant is referred to throughout.

accused_gender.quote: the accused forcibly committed sexual assault/rape on her
accused_gender.reason: Accused is referred to as male (he/his) throughout.

accused_age.reason: The judgment gives no age for the accused; the value 25 has no basis in the text.

accused_religion.reason: Judgment does not state the accused's religion.

accused_caste.reason: Judgment does not state the accused's caste.

accused_occupation.reason: Accused's occupation is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Socioeconomic status of the accused is not discussed.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.quote: the victim girl who was only 17 years
victim_gender.reason: Victim is a female girl throughout.

victim_age.quote: the prosecutrix/the victim girl aged 17 years
victim_age.reason: Judgment states the victim was aged 17 years and a minor.

victim_caste.reason: Victim's caste is not stated in the judgment.

victim_religion.reason: Victim's religion is not stated in the judgment.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: Judgment never describes the relationship; 'Stranger' is not supported by the text.

offence_category.reason: Offence is rape under Section 376 IPC.

statutory_provisions.correct_value: IPC s. 376 read with s. 506-1; Evidence Act s. 114-A
statutory_provisions.quote: Section 376 read with Section 506-1 of the Indian Penal Code
statutory_provisions.reason: Omits Section 506-1 IPC and Evidence Act s.114-A, both central to the judgment.

weapon.reason: No weapon used by the accused is mentioned; poison was consumed by the victim.

evidence_type.correct_value: Oral testimony of prosecutrix, medical evidence, circumstantial evidence, corroboration by father and brother
evidence_type.quote: The prosecutrix victim has stood the test of cross examination
evidence_type.reason: No dying declaration is mentioned; the victim survived and her oral account was relied upon.

confession.reason: No confession by the accused is mentioned.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: Judgment does not label any aggravating circumstances.

trial_court_outcome.quote: the learned Session Judge ... convicted and sentenced the accused as noted above
trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted and sentenced the accused to seven years.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Appeal dismissed; conviction and sentence upheld on 29.09.2009
high_court_outcome.quote: the appeal preferred by the appellant was dismissed by the High Court
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court dismissed the appeal and upheld conviction and sentence; value says not applicable.

final_outcome.quote: we find no substance in this appeal and hence uphold the conviction and sentence

offence_finally_established.quote: the offence of rape would be held to have been proved

imprisonment_type.quote: sentence of seven years imposed on the appellant
imprisonment_type.reason: Fixed-term imprisonment of seven years, described as rigorous imprisonment in headnote.

imprisonment_years.quote: sentence of seven years imposed on the appellant

neutral_facts.correct_value: Neutral facts only: accused charged with rape of 17-year-old; victim attempted suicide after alleged rape; FIR lodged 11.09.2006 after discharge; doctor did not categorically deny hymen rupture; appeal raised delay, enmity and medical defences. No outcome or reasoning.
neutral_facts.quote: the Doctor has not categorically denied the rupture of hymen
neutral_facts.reason: Says hymen was intact (doctor was non-committal), says victim's family lodged FIR, and reveals court's reasoning and outcome.
neutral_facts._note: Court findings included, violating neutral requirement.

offence_severity.quote: sentence of seven years imposed on the appellant
offence_severity.reason: Seven years imprisonment is supported as the severity measure.

attempt_completion.quote: the accused forcibly committed sexual assault/rape on her against her wish
attempt_completion.reason: Rape is alleged as committed, and the court found it proved.

physical_harm.quote: suffered the risk of death after consuming poison
physical_harm.reason: Trauma from rape and risk of death from poison consumption are both described.

number_of_offences.correct_value: 2 offences charged (s. 376 and s. 506-1 IPC); both upheld
number_of_offences.quote: conviction of the appellant under Section 376 read with Section 506-1 of the Indian Penal Code was upheld
number_of_offences.reason: Value omits Section 506-1 IPC; two offences were charged and upheld, not one.

financial_property_loss.reason: No financial or property loss is involved.

motive.correct_value: Defence alleged previous enmity with victim's family; prosecution motive not stated
motive.quote: the appellant was falsely implicated due to enmity
motive.reason: Value says not identified, but defence attributed false implication to enmity.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: The delay in lodging the FIR thus stands fully explained
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Delay explanation and victim's version relied upon as stated.

witness_credibility.quote: The prosecutrix victim has stood the test of cross examination
witness_credibility.reason: Cross-examination and corroboration by father and brother are described.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: After raping her, the accused left and threatened her not to disclose the incident.
post_offence_conduct.quote: threatened her that in case she disclosed the incident to anyone
post_offence_conduct.reason: Judgment states the accused threatened the victim after the rape; 'Not stated' is wrong.

custody_duration.reason: Duration of custody is not stated; only arrest date is given.

trial_duration.reason: Offence, High Court and Supreme Court dates are supported; trial judgment date not given.

legal_representation.quote: Anne Mathew, A.C., Rishi Maheshwari, R.V. Kameshwaran for the Appellant
legal_representation.reason: Counsel names match the judgment; amicus was appointed for appellant.

investigation_status.reason: FIR date, chargesheet and completed trial are supported.

procedural_irregularity.quote: This appeal was going unrepresented as no one had appeared for the appellant
procedural_irregularity.reason: No irregularity is identified; amicus was appointed to address unrepresented appeal.

appeal_history.correct_value: Trial court: convicted and sentenced; High Court: appeal dismissed, conviction upheld; Supreme Court: appeal dismissed
appeal_history.quote: the conviction of the appellant under Section 376 read with Section 506-1 of the Indian Penal Code was upheld
appeal_history.reason: Trial court convicted rather than upheld a conviction; no appeal from trial court is described.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: Prosecution relied on the time gap, victim's testimony, and corroboration; the courts (not the prosecution) found the hymen evidence insignificant
prosecution_argument.quote: the medical report of the prosecutrix not reflecting sexual act is not of much significance, as per the view taken by the courts below
prosecution_argument.reason: Hymen-significance view is attributed to the courts below, not the prosecution's argument.

defence_argument.quote: it was sought to be explained that the prosecutrix was suffering from the fear of compartmental examination
defence_argument.reason: Enmity, delay, intact hymen and examination-fear arguments are all supported.

legal_principle_applied.quote: the offence of rape would be held to have been proved even if there is an attempt of rape on the woman
legal_principle_applied.reason: Principle on attempt and victim's version is stated in the judgment.

precedent_relied_upon.correct_value: No case precedent cited; relies on statutory s. 114-A Evidence Act
precedent_relied_upon.quote: the amendment introduced in the Indian Evidence Act, 1872 in Section 114-A
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Section 114-A is a statute, not precedent; no case law is cited.

sentencing_rationale.correct_value: No separate sentencing reasoning; sentence upheld as conviction was proved beyond reasonable doubt
sentencing_rationale.quote: we find no substance in this appeal and hence uphold the conviction and sentence
sentencing_rationale.reason: Judgment gives no separate sentencing rationale; reasoning relates to conviction.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: No mitigating factors are discussed by the court.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Court does not label aggravating factors; none expressly identified.

other_sentence_order.quote: simple imprisonment for a period of one year under Section 376 IPC
other_sentence_order.reason: Fine, default terms and sentence are supported by the judgment.
